1.web: Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you.
1.asv: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah, And let my cry come unto thee.

2.web: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.
2.asv: Hide not thy face from me in the day of my distress: Incline thine ear unto me; In the day when I call answer me speedily.

3.web: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
3.asv: For my days consume away like smoke, And my bones are burned as a firebrand.

4.web: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
4.asv: My heart is smitten like grass, and withered; For I forget to eat my bread.

5.web: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.
5.asv: By reason of the voice of my groaning My bones cleave to my flesh.

6.web: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.
6.asv: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am become as an owl of the waste places.

7.web: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
7.asv: I watch, and am become like a sparrow That is alone upon the house-top.

8.web: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.
8.asv: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; They that are mad against me do curse by me.

9.web: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
9.asv: For I have eaten ashes like bread, And mingled my drink with weeping,

10.web: Because of your indignation and your wrath, for you have taken me up, and thrown me away.
10.asv: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: For thou hast taken me up, and cast me away.

11.web: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
11.asv: My days are like a shadow that declineth; And I am withered like grass.

12.web: But you, Yahweh, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.
12.asv: But thou, O Jehovah, wilt abide for ever; And thy memorial name unto all generations.

13.web: You will arise and have mercy on Zion; for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.
13.asv: Thou wilt arise, and have mercy upon Zion; For it is time to have pity upon her, Yea, the set time is come.

14.web: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.
14.asv: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, And have pity upon her dust.

15.web: So the nations will fear Yahweh’s name; all the kings of the earth your glory.
15.asv: So the nations shall fear the name of Jehovah, And all the kings of the earth thy glory.

16.web: For Yahweh has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.
16.asv: For Jehovah hath built up Zion; He hath appeared in his glory.

17.web: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
17.asv: He hath regarded the prayer of the destitute, And hath not despised their prayer.

18.web: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise Yah.
18.asv: This shall be written for the generation to come; And a people which shall be created shall praise Jehovah.

19.web: For he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, Yahweh saw the earth;
19.asv: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; From heaven did Jehovah behold the earth;

20.web: to hear the groans of the prisoner; to free those who are condemned to death;
20.asv: To hear the sighing of the prisoner; To loose those that are appointed to death;

21.web: that men may declare Yahweh’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
21.asv: That men may declare the name of Jehovah in Zion, And his praise in Jerusalem;

22.web: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve Yahweh.
22.asv: When the peoples are gathered together, And the kingdoms, to serve Jehovah.

23.web: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.
23.asv: He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.

24.web: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the midst of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.
24.asv: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: Thy years are throughout all generations.

25.web: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.
25.asv: Of old didst thou lay the foundation of the earth; And the heavens are the work of thy hands.

26.web: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.
26.asv: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure; Yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; As a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:

27.web: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.
27.asv: But thou art the same, And thy years shall have no end.

28.web: The children of your servants will continue. Their seed will be established before you.”
28.asv: The children of thy servants shall continue, And their seed shall be established before thee.
